messages:
Elaine: Quick heads up — I ran into a 404 on the onboarding flow. KB link in /onboard/quickstart points to /kb/enterprise/sso-setup and returns 404. spotted during customer QA this morning.
DevDocs Bot: automated link-check: 1 broken link detected in /kb/onboarding/quickstart (rule: outbound-links). More details: https://internal.devdocs/scan/3245 ✅
Sam: hmm that was the nav rename friday — I moved SSO content under /kb/auth/ but forgot to add a redirect back. my bad.
Jin: I can open a quick PR to update the inbound links and add an entry in the redirects map. TL;DR: small change, safe to ship. assigning to myself.
Priyanka: if you're touching the quickstart, can you also tweak the first paragraph? it reads a bit heavy — suggest changing "IdP" -> "identity provider" for clarity (customer-facing).
Jin: yep will include the copy tweak. plan: 1) update internal links in onboarding templates 2) add redirect rule in infra/redirects.yaml 3) add one-line changelog entry. quick sed I plan to run in the repo:
```bash
# replace old path with new
rg -l "/kb/enterprise/sso-setup" | xargs sed -i 's|/kb/enterprise/sso-setup|/kb/auth/sso-setup|g'
# normalize IdP -> identity provider in quickstart
sed -i 's/\bIdP\b/identity provider/g' content/kb/onboarding/quickstart.md
```
Mike: if you add a redirect, please coordinate with infra — we need a deploy window for redirect-map changes. @DeployBot any slots today? :eyes:
DeployBot: Deploy slots available: 16:00 UTC and 22:00 UTC. Reply with preferred slot and I'll schedule. :calendar:
Elaine: 16:00 UTC works for the customer QA window. Jin — can you aim to have the PR ready by 15:00 so we can review before deploy?
Jin: got it. PR incoming (draft) in ~30m. I'll ping here when it's ready.
DevDocs Bot: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/2345 — includes link fixes + redirect map entry + changelog. CI: checks running.
Priyanka: thanks all. if CI is green i can do a quick review after lunch. otherwise ping me. :pray:
Sam: small follow-up — once redirect exists, could we add a short note in the onboarding checklist so future renames include redirect chore? i can add that as a TODO in the repo template.
Elaine: nice. thanks everyone. short and tidy. :white_check_mark:
